def topKFrequent (nums : List Int) (k : Nat) (h_precond : topKFrequent_precond (nums) (k)) : List Int :=
  if nums = [] then []
  else
    let counts := nums.map (fun x => (x, nums.count x))
    let max_freq := counts.map (fun (x, c) => c) |>.maximum.getD 0
    let freq_to_elems := counts.filter (fun (x, c) => c = max_freq) |>.map (fun (x, _) => x)
    let result := freq_to_elems.take k
    if result.length = k then result
    else []
